# Krave Kulture

Haitian, Caribbean and soul food truck in Miami, FL. Tagline: "Krave It. Taste It. Live the Kulture."

- Menu and how to pay: https://eatkravekulture.com/menu.html
- Home (scroll story): https://eatkravekulture.com/
- QR code for print: https://eatkravekulture.com/qr.html
- Instagram (current location, posted daily): https://www.instagram.com/eatkravekulture/
- Terms & conditions: https://eatkravekulture.com/terms.html
- Privacy policy: https://eatkravekulture.com/privacy.html

The truck has no fixed address; it moves around Miami and posts the day's spot on Instagram. Menu prices and availability are on the menu page and change with the market.
